purpose: Rank the thirty highest-value operational controls for live RAFAELIA evolution without converting a score into proof.

scoring_boundary.rank_means: relative implementation priority under current assumptions
scoring_boundary.rank_does_not_mean: truth, certification, compliance, publication readiness or scientific validation

practices.control_objective: Bind every change to source SHA, tests, receipt, review state and rollback point.
practices.falsifier: A promoted change lacking source identity, test evidence, receipt or rollback invalidates the control.
practices.next_step: Bind all promotion edges to exact head SHA, evidence receipt and rollback checkpoint.

practices.control_objective: Use read-only defaults, minimal token permissions and protected promotion edges.
practices.falsifier: Unnecessary write permission or unreviewed direct promotion invalidates the control.
practices.next_step: Verify rulesets externally and require least-privilege checks on every promotion edge.

practices.control_objective: Hash-bind canonical inputs, environment, commands, outputs and decisions.
practices.falsifier: A result not reproducible from its receipt or with digest mismatch invalidates evidence.
practices.next_step: Standardize one receipt schema across Mapa, RLL, Termux and producer repositories.

practices.control_objective: Reproduce artifacts or declared numerical tolerances from a clean checkout and pinned toolchain.
practices.falsifier: Different artifacts or unbounded drift from identical inputs falsifies reproducibility.
practices.next_step: Run exact clean checkouts on CI and Termux and compare hashes or tolerances.

practices.control_objective: Block unsafe promotion with positive, negative, adversarial and domain falsifier tests.
practices.falsifier: Promotion with failing or absent mandatory falsifiers invalidates the gate.
practices.next_step: Map every promotable claim to an executable falsifier and negative test.

practices.control_objective: Preserve a tested rollback point and prior receipt for every mutable deployment.
practices.falsifier: An irreversible change or untested restore path invalidates the checkpoint.
practices.next_step: Create restore KATs for index, configuration, artifact and release transitions.

practices.control_objective: Keep secrets external, scoped, rotated and redacted.
practices.falsifier: Plaintext credentials, overbroad tokens or leaked logs invalidate the control.
practices.next_step: Complete secret scanning, rotation receipts and push-protection verification.

practices.control_objective: Pin, review, inventory and verify dependencies and external actions.
practices.falsifier: Mutable action references, unreviewed drift or missing provenance invalidates integrity.
practices.next_step: Enable Dependency Graph, complete dependency review and materialize SBOM receipts.

practices.control_objective: Expose structured status, timestamps, causes, metrics and artifact links without sensitive data.
practices.falsifier: A failure with no steps, logs, receipt or diagnosable residue invalidates observability.
practices.next_step: Normalize structured logs and failure receipts for every critical workflow.

practices.control_objective: Define and exercise severity, owner, containment, communication and evidence preservation.
practices.falsifier: An incident without ownership or preserved evidence invalidates readiness.
practices.next_step: Exercise one tabletop incident scenario with a timed receipt.

practices.control_objective: Link every dataset and derivative to source, revision, transformation, rights, digest and decision.
practices.falsifier: An orphan derivative or unverifiable source breaks lineage.
practices.next_step: Extend Drive↔GitHub lineage to real corpus files with hashes and revision IDs.

practices.control_objective: Version backups and periodically prove restoration.
practices.falsifier: A backup not restorable within declared objectives is treated as absent.
practices.next_step: Run a non-destructive restore drill and seal RPO/RTO evidence.

practices.control_objective: Measure availability, correctness, latency and freshness against explicit objectives.
practices.falsifier: Missing measurement or sustained breach without action invalidates the SLO state.
practices.next_step: Define first SLIs/SLOs for cycle freshness, receipt success and index equivalence.

practices.control_objective: Require independent review for high-impact decisions and prohibit self-approval.
practices.falsifier: Self-approval or missing independent review invalidates promotion eligibility.
practices.next_step: Bind reviewer identity and reviewed digest to promotion receipts.

practices.control_objective: Preserve historical receipts and negative results with chain or digest verification.
practices.falsifier: Silent overwrite, deletion or history rewrite invalidates continuity.
practices.next_step: Add chain verification across consecutive cycle receipts and catalog events.

practices.control_objective: Version assets, trust boundaries, adversaries, misuse paths and mitigations.
practices.falsifier: An unmodeled high-impact boundary or bypass invalidates completeness.
practices.next_step: Create a GitHub↔Drive↔Termux threat model and derive abuse-case tests.

practices.control_objective: Process only necessary metadata and preserve authority, consent and private-text boundaries.
practices.falsifier: Unnecessary private exposure or processing without authority invalidates the control.
practices.next_step: Run privacy review against carrier schemas, logs and uploaded artifacts.

practices.control_objective: Promote through isolated stages with a new receipt at each edge.
practices.falsifier: Skipping a maturity edge or reusing stale evidence invalidates promotion.
practices.next_step: Apply the staged promotion contract beyond RLL to critical repositories.

practices.control_objective: Measure latency, throughput, memory and size distributions with reproducible baselines.
practices.falsifier: A performance claim without distribution, environment or baseline is invalid.
practices.next_step: Benchmark incremental indexing and critical pipelines at multiple corpus sizes.

practices.control_objective: Declare budgets for time, CPU, memory, storage, network and CI use.
practices.falsifier: Unbounded consumption or hidden cost invalidates operational readiness.
practices.next_step: Add resource telemetry and breach thresholds to scheduled cycles.

practices.control_objective: Test corrupt input, missing dependency, timeout, deletion, drift and rollback paths.
practices.falsifier: A failure mode bypassing fail-closed behavior invalidates resilience.
practices.next_step: Add deterministic fault campaigns for receipts, indexes and external-state gaps.

practices.control_objective: Compare schema, output, dependency, semantic and performance drift against baselines.
practices.falsifier: Undetected or unexplained drift across equivalent runs invalidates stability.
practices.next_step: Create delta receipts for Top-30 state, workflow contract and performance baselines.

practices.control_objective: Declare and test supported OS, Python, architecture, Android, Termux and toolchains.
practices.falsifier: Claiming support for an untested environment invalidates the matrix.
practices.next_step: Materialize Linux, Android/Termux, ARMv7 and ARM64 compatibility evidence.

practices.control_objective: Keep outputs navigable, readable and usable on constrained and assistive devices.
practices.falsifier: Critical information inaccessible to intended users invalidates usability readiness.
practices.next_step: Audit dashboard and receipts for mobile readability, dyslexia support and accessible structure.

practices.control_objective: Keep decisions, procedures, ownership and recovery steps current and linked to code.
practices.falsifier: A critical mechanism without a current runbook or decision record invalidates readiness.
practices.next_step: Generate ADR and runbook coverage for all Top-10 controls.

practices.control_objective: Verify rights, attribution and external-authority boundaries for datasets, code and publications.
practices.falsifier: Unknown license or unauthorized redistribution blocks publication and release.
practices.next_step: Complete rights receipts for real datasets, papers and bundled artifacts.

practices.control_objective: Reproduce declared results on a second machine, implementation or independent review.
practices.falsifier: Only-author or only-environment evidence cannot satisfy independence.
practices.next_step: Execute independent RLL and runtime receipts and bind reviewer/environment identities.

practices.control_objective: Measure growth assumptions, saturation points and degradation behavior.
practices.falsifier: Failure before declared capacity or no saturation measurement invalidates readiness.
practices.next_step: Run scale tests on Drive catalog, knowledge forest and receipt storage.

practices.control_objective: Define retention, archival, expiration, deprecation and safe disposal.
practices.falsifier: Orphan data, indefinite sensitive retention or unsafe deletion invalidates lifecycle control.
practices.next_step: Define tier-specific retention and decommission receipts without deleting canonical history.

practices.control_objective: Record F_ok, F_gap, F_next, owner, due evidence and prior-action outcome each cycle.
practices.falsifier: Repeated cycles with no measured learning or ownerless gaps invalidate improvement.
practices.next_step: Measure closure rate, aging and recurrence of TOKEN_VAZIO items across 42 cycles.
